title: ML on partial-charge dynamics identifies residues driving mimochrome reactivity
summary: Classical and ab initio molecular dynamics of three mimochrome artificial metalloenzymes were analysed with supervised machine-learning classifiers trained on partial-charge dynamics alone to tell the analogues apart. The classifiers flagged residues including Arg10', Lys11, Glu2' and Ser6', and a predicted Glu2'-Lys11 salt bridge was disrupted in a newly synthesised analogue, MC6*a-LysBoc, giving a seven-fold decrease in total turnover number. Quantum mechanical calculations indicate Arg10' stabilises the transition state for forming the reactive oxo. Machine learning is one step alongside molecular dynamics and quantum calculations, and only one analogue was tested.
ai_technology: Supervised machine-learning classifiers trained on ab initio MD partial-charge dynamics
